payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information on how the tweets were annotated, including the stance classification and the filtering process.

claims.text: The tweets were filtered using names of target clubs and annotated for stance as Favor or Against.
A total of 700 tweets were annotated, with 175 tweets in favor of and 175 against each of the two targets.
The stance annotations were made publicly available in a CSV format containing tweet id, target name, and stance.
The study did not annotate tweets with the Neither class, focusing only on Favor or Against.
